summary: Builds up to four texture-variant paths with a letter suffix and submits each to TextureAdjuster. Copies the incoming filename a2 into a local buffer, splits it at the first '.' (v2 = sub_589DB0(v11, 46)); when a dot is found the extension (dot included) is copied into v12 and v11 is truncated at the dot, otherwise v12 is filled from the default-extension string global byte_5D6F48. When the base name's last character is in 'A'..'D' (ASCII 65..68) it is stripped from v11. Then, for v7 = 65..68 and exactly 4 iterations, formats the variant path '%s%c%s' into v14, the plain name+extension '%s%s' into v15, restores v16 = a2, formats the prefix+letter '%s%c' into v13, and calls TextureAdjuster(v13, 1, v14, v15, v16, 0, 0), keeping the last result as the return value.

local_names.a1: texture directory/prefix string used to build the variant path
local_names.v11: working copy of a2, truncated at the extension dot
local_names.v12: extension string (dot included) or default extension from byte_5D6F48
local_names.v16: second copy of the original filename a2

operations.description: Copies the incoming filename a2 into the local buffer v11 via strcpy.
sub_589DB0(v11, 46) searches v11 for the '.' character (46); its result v2 is used to split name from extension.
When v2 is non-null the filename contained a dot; otherwise v11 has no extension and the default-extension path is taken.
Dot path: copies the extension starting at v2 (dot included) into v12, then nulls *v2 so v11 is truncated at the extension dot.
No-dot path: copies the default extension string from the global byte_5D6F48 into v12.
Computes v5 = strlen(v11) to test whether the base name is non-empty.
When the base name is non-empty and its last character is in the range 65..68 ('A'..'D'), that trailing letter is stripped by nulling it.
Loop of exactly 4 iterations: v7 runs from 65 to 68 ('A'..'D') while v8 counts down from 4; the loop does not exit early.

StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v14, aSS, v11, v7, v12) formats the variant path '%s%c%s' (base name + letter + extension); aSS (0x005BE860) is the read-only format-string global the raw source renders as that literal.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v15, aSC, v11, v12) formats the plain '%s%s' name+extension string; aSC (0x005D6F38) is the read-only format-string global for that literal.
strcpy(v16, a2) restores a fresh copy of the original filename for each variant iteration.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v13, aSCS, a1, v7) formats the '%s%c' prefix+letter string; aSCS (0x005D6F40) is the read-only format-string global for that literal.
TextureAdjuster(v13, 1, v14, v15, v16, 0, 0) registers/adjusts the texture for the current letter variant; the last call's result is kept as the function return value.
Invoked by sub_4FC550 (0x004FC550), the callers list entry.
